senses: The study of quantities, shapes, and relationships using logical rules

ex.en: I packed my lunch and jacket in a rucksack.
ex.zh: 我把午餐和夹克装进了双肩背包。

ex.en: Travellers carrying only a rucksack can move more easily between public transport services.
ex.zh: 只背一个双肩包的旅行者换乘公共交通时行动更方便。

ext.tip: 英式英语常用rucksack；不限定帆布材质。
senses: A bag carried on your back using shoulder straps.

ex.en: Please use these scissors to cut the wrapping paper.
ex.zh: 请用这把剪刀裁剪包装纸。

ex.en: Teachers should supervise young children when they use scissors during classroom craft activities.
ex.zh: 幼儿在课堂手工活动中使用剪刀时，教师应在旁监督。

ext.tip: 通常用复数；一把剪刀说a pair of scissors。
senses: A tool with two blades for cutting things.

ex.en: I checked the timetable before leaving for the station.
ex.zh: 去车站前，我查看了时刻表。

ext.tip: 英式常用timetable；美式常用schedule。
senses: A schedule showing when lessons, journeys, or other events happen.
To arrange when an event or activity will happen.

ex.en: We watched a funny cartoon about a dancing penguin.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于跳舞企鹅的搞笑动画片。

ex.en: Political cartoons can communicate complex social criticism through simple images that appeal to a wide audience.
ex.zh: 政治漫画可以通过简单的图像传达复杂的社会批评，吸引广泛的受众。

ext.tip: cartoon 可指动画片或单幅漫画；漫画书常用 comic。
senses: a film or programme made using animated drawings or images
a humorous drawing, often commenting on society or politics

ex.en: My grandfather taught me chess during the winter holidays.
ex.zh: 寒假期间，爷爷教我下国际象棋。

ex.en: Playing chess regularly may help children develop concentration and practise planning several steps ahead.
ex.zh: 经常下国际象棋可能有助于儿童提高专注力，并练习提前规划多个步骤。

ext.tip: 说play chess，不加冠词the。
senses: a two-player board game involving pieces with different permitted moves

ex.en: We enjoyed an outdoor concert in the park yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在公园欣赏了一场露天音乐会。

ex.en: Free public concerts can make cultural activities more accessible and encourage residents to use shared urban spaces.
ex.zh: 免费公共音乐会能让更多人参与文化活动，并鼓励居民使用城市公共空间。

ext.tip: 去听音乐会用 go to a concert。
senses: a live musical performance given before an audience

ex.en: The little boy beat the drum with both hands.
ex.zh: 小男孩用双手敲鼓。

ex.en: Learning to play the drum can help children develop coordination and participate in group performances.
ex.zh: 学习打鼓能帮助儿童培养协调能力，并参与集体表演。

ext.tip: play the drums常指打鼓；drum也可指大圆桶。
senses: a musical instrument played by hitting its stretched surface
a large cylindrical container for storing liquids or other materials
to play a drum or tap something repeatedly

ex.en: Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.
ex.zh: 我们镇每年秋天都会举办灯会。

ex.en: An annual arts festival can attract visitors while providing local performers with valuable opportunities to reach wider audiences.
ex.zh: 一年一度的艺术节既能吸引游客，也能为当地表演者提供接触更多观众的宝贵机会。

ext.tip: festival强调庆祝或系列活动，不一定是放假的holiday。
senses: A special occasion when people celebrate a tradition or event
An organised series of performances or other cultural events

ex.en: She used a flashlight to look under the bed.
ex.zh: 她用手电筒照着查看床底。

ext.tip: 手电筒的美式说法；英式通常用torch。
senses: A small portable electric light powered by batteries.

ex.en: My grandfather plays golf with his friends every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我祖父每周日都和朋友打高尔夫球。

col: 高尔夫球杆；高尔夫俱乐部

ex.en: Golf courses can attract tourists, but maintaining their grass may require considerable amounts of water.
ex.zh: 高尔夫球场可以吸引游客，但养护草坪可能需要大量用水。

ext.tip: 球类运动前通常不加冠词：play golf。
senses: A sport hitting a small ball into holes with clubs

ex.en: My sister plays a different instrument at each rehearsal.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每次排练都演奏不同的乐器。

ex.en: Learning a musical instrument can strengthen concentration and encourage cooperation among children from different backgrounds.
ex.zh: 学习乐器可以增强专注力，并促进不同背景的儿童之间的合作。

ext.tip: 乐器和精密仪器均可用instrument；普通工具常用tool。
senses: an object played to produce musical sounds
a tool or device for precise scientific or medical work
something used to achieve a particular purpose

ex.en: We received an invitation to our neighbour's garden party.
ex.zh: 我们收到了邻居花园聚会的邀请。

ex.en: An invitation to participate in local planning can encourage residents to take greater responsibility for their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 邀请居民参与地方规划，可以鼓励他们为社区承担更多责任。

ext.tip: 参加活动用invitation to；邀请做事用to do。
senses: a request for someone to attend or join something

ex.en: She bought a gardening magazine at the station.
ex.zh: 她在车站买了一本园艺杂志。

ex.en: A specialist magazine can provide practical career advice that general news websites may not offer.
ex.zh: 专业杂志可以提供综合新闻网站未必能提供的实用职业建议。

ext.tip: 可数名词；英式重音通常在末音节，美式在首音节。
senses: A regularly published collection of articles and pictures.

ex.en: I joined a fitness programme at the local gym.
ex.zh: 我参加了当地健身房的一项健身计划。

ex.en: A well-designed training programme can help unemployed adults gain the skills needed for new careers.
ex.zh: 设计合理的培训项目能帮助失业成年人掌握新职业所需的技能。

ext.tip: 英式通常用programme，计算机程序用program；美式均用program。
senses: an organised set of activities with a particular purpose
a show broadcast on television or radio
to arrange activities or set a machine to operate automatically

ex.en: We finished the puzzle together on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房桌上一起完成了拼图。

ex.en: The relationship between income and personal happiness remains a puzzle that researchers approach from several different perspectives.
ex.zh: 收入与个人幸福感之间的关系仍是一个谜，研究人员正从多个不同角度探索它。

ext.tip: puzzled形容人感到困惑；puzzling形容事物令人困惑。
senses: A game or problem that tests your thinking skills.
Something that is difficult to understand or explain.
To make someone feel confused because something is difficult to understand.

ex.en: We built a small pyramid out of wooden blocks.
ex.zh: 我们用木块搭了一座小金字塔。

ex.en: The management pyramid in many organisations places a small group of executives above numerous employees.
ex.zh: 许多机构的金字塔式管理结构将少数高管置于众多员工之上。

ext.tip: 既指古代金字塔，也指几何中的棱锥体。
senses: a structure with triangular sides meeting at a point
a system with fewer members at each successively higher level

ex.en: We played a music quiz after dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们玩了音乐知识问答游戏。

ex.en: A short quiz at the beginning of each lesson can help teachers identify gaps in students' understanding.
ex.zh: 每节课开始时的小测验可以帮助教师发现学生理解上的不足。

ext.tip: 复数为quizzes；过去式为quizzed。
senses: A short test or game involving questions.
To test someone's knowledge or ask them detailed questions.

ex.en: We learned to ski on a gentle snowy slope.
ex.zh: 我们在一处平缓的雪坡上学会了滑雪。

ex.en: Tourists who ski in mountain resorts contribute to local employment but may also increase environmental pressure.
ex.zh: 在山地度假区滑雪的游客促进了当地就业，但也可能增加环境压力。

ext.tip: 过去式skied，现在分词skiing；ski复数为skis。
senses: to move over snow wearing long narrow boards on your feet
a long narrow board worn on a foot for travelling over snow

ex.en: I tried snowboarding yesterday and landed in soft snow.
ex.zh: 昨天我尝试了单板滑雪，摔进了松软的雪里。

ex.en: Snowboarding lessons should include safety training so that beginners can share mountain slopes responsibly.
ex.zh: 单板滑雪课程应包含安全训练，让初学者能负责任地与他人共用山坡雪道。

ext.tip: snowboarding双脚固定在一块板上，区别于双板滑雪。
senses: The sport of travelling down snowy slopes on one board.

ex.en: Her suitcase was too heavy to lift onto the train.
ex.zh: 她的行李箱太重，搬不上火车。

ex.en: Travellers can reduce transport emissions by packing a lighter suitcase and choosing public transport whenever possible.
ex.zh: 旅客可以通过减轻行李箱的重量，并尽量选择公共交通来减少交通排放。

ext.tip: suitcase可数；统称行李的luggage不可数。
senses: A case with a handle for carrying clothes when travelling.

ex.en: We pitched our tent beside a quiet lake.
ex.zh: 我们在一个宁静的湖边搭起帐篷。

ex.en: Visitors who sleep in a tent should follow campsite rules to minimise their impact on local wildlife.
ex.zh: 住帐篷的游客应遵守营地规定，尽量减少对当地野生动物的影响。

ext.tip: “搭帐篷”用pitch或put up a tent。
senses: a portable fabric shelter supported by poles and ropes

ex.en: I used a torch to find my missing keys.
ex.zh: 我用手电筒寻找丢失的钥匙。

ex.en: Hikers should carry a torch and spare batteries when exploring remote areas after sunset.
ex.zh: 徒步者在日落后探索偏远地区时，应携带手电筒和备用电池。

ext.tip: 手电筒英式叫torch，美式叫flashlight。
senses: A small electric light carried in the hand.
A stick with burning material at one end, providing light.

ex.en: My brother whistled a cheerful tune while washing dishes.
ex.zh: 哥哥洗碗时，用口哨吹着一段欢快的曲调。

ex.en: A memorable tune can help young learners retain new vocabulary and develop greater confidence in speaking.
ex.zh: 容易记住的曲调可以帮助低龄学习者记忆新词汇，并增强口语表达的信心。

ext.tip: in tune指音调准确；out of tune指走调。
senses: a series of musical notes forming a recognizable pattern
to adjust an instrument so it produces the correct notes
to adjust a device to work or receive signals correctly

ex.en: We stopped beside the road to change a flat tyre.
ex.zh: 我们在路边停下来，更换一个瘪了的轮胎。

ex.en: Recycling used tyres can reduce landfill waste and provide materials for safer playground surfaces.
ex.zh: 回收旧轮胎可以减少填埋垃圾，并为更安全的游乐场地面提供材料。

ext.tip: tyre是英式拼写，美式拼写为tire。
senses: A rubber covering around a wheel that touches the road.

ex.en: My sister practises the violin after dinner every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后都练习小提琴。

ex.en: Learning the violin can help children develop concentration, although regular lessons may be expensive for some families.
ex.zh: 学习小提琴有助于儿童培养专注力，但定期上课对某些家庭来说可能费用较高。

ext.tip: 小提琴手是violinist；拉小提琴常说play the violin。
senses: A four-stringed instrument held under the chin and usually bowed.

ex.en: We played volleyball on the beach until the sun set.
ex.zh: 我们在沙滩上打排球，一直打到日落。

ex.en: Team sports such as volleyball can help students develop communication skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 排球等团队运动既能帮助学生培养沟通能力，也能鼓励他们定期锻炼。

ext.tip: 指运动时不可数，play volleyball中不加冠词。
senses: A game of hitting a ball over a high net.

ex.en: My alarm rings at seven a.m. every weekday.
ex.zh: 每个工作日，我的闹钟都在早上七点响。

ex.en: Starting school before eight a.m. may reduce the amount of sleep that teenagers get on weekdays.
ex.zh: 早上八点前上课可能会减少青少年在上学期间的睡眠时间。

ext.tip: 放在钟点后；12 a.m.是午夜，12 p.m.是正午。
senses: During the time from midnight until just before midday.

ex.en: I marked our camping weekend on the kitchen calendar.
ex.zh: 我在厨房的日历上标出了周末露营的日子。

ex.en: Schools should publish an annual calendar so families can plan holidays around important educational events.
ex.zh: 学校应公布年度日程表，方便家庭避开重要教学活动来安排假期。

ext.tip: calendar year指一月至十二月，不等于学年。
senses: A chart of dates or a schedule of events.
A system for dividing time into years, months, and days.

ex.en: My sister starts her new job in February.
ex.zh: 我姐姐二月份开始新工作。

ex.en: The community centre will introduce additional evening classes in February to meet growing demand.
ex.zh: 社区中心将在二月份增设夜间课程，以满足不断增长的需求。

ext.tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。
senses: The second month of the year.

ex.en: We stopped for a picnic beside the lake at midday.
ex.zh: 中午，我们停下来在湖边野餐。

ex.en: Outdoor workers should avoid direct sunlight around midday to reduce the risk of heat exhaustion.
ex.zh: 户外工作者应避免在中午前后受到阳光直射，以降低热衰竭的风险。

ext.tip: 时间前用at；也可置于名词前，如midday sun。
senses: the middle of the day, around twelve o'clock

ex.en: The swimming pool closes at eight p.m. today.
ex.zh: 游泳池今天晚上八点关门。

ex.en: Keeping public libraries open until nine p.m. would allow more working adults to access educational resources.
ex.zh: 让公共图书馆开放至晚上九点，可以使更多在职成年人获取教育资源。

ext.tip: 放在时间后；12 p.m.是中午，12 a.m.是午夜。
senses: after noon and before midnight, used when stating a time

ex.en: We dropped the anchor beside a quiet island.
ex.zh: 我们在一座宁静的小岛旁抛了锚。

ex.en: Strong community networks can provide an anchor for families adapting to life in unfamiliar cities.
ex.zh: 紧密的社区网络可以为适应陌生城市生活的家庭提供可靠的依靠。

ext.tip: drop anchor指抛锚；weigh anchor指起锚，不是称重。
senses: A heavy object that holds a boat in place underwater.
To secure a boat with an anchor or fix something firmly.

ex.en: I locked my bicycle outside the small bakery.
ex.zh: 我把自行车锁在那家小面包店外面。

ex.en: Travelling by bicycle can reduce urban air pollution while providing residents with regular physical exercise.
ex.zh: 骑自行车出行既能减少城市空气污染，也能让居民经常锻炼身体。

ext.tip: by bicycle不加冠词；ride a bicycle要加冠词。
senses: a two-wheeled vehicle moved by pushing pedals

ex.en: We took the ferry across the lake this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我们乘渡船穿过了湖。

ex.en: Reliable ferry services connect island communities with mainland hospitals, schools, and employment opportunities throughout the year.
ex.zh: 可靠的轮渡服务全年将岛屿社区与大陆的医院、学校和就业机会连接起来。

ext.tip: 复数为ferries；动词也可指用车反复接送。
senses: A boat carrying passengers or vehicles across water regularly.
To carry people or goods between places, often repeatedly.

ex.en: We left the motorway and stopped for lunch.
ex.zh: 我们驶离高速公路，停下来吃午饭。

ex.en: Building a new motorway may reduce journey times, but it can also damage nearby wildlife habitats.
ex.zh: 修建新的高速公路可能缩短行程时间，但也会破坏附近的野生动物栖息地。

ext.tip: 主要用于英式英语；美式常用freeway。
senses: a wide road designed for fast travel over long distances

ex.en: Her parachute opened smoothly above the green fields.
ex.zh: 她的降落伞在绿色田野上空顺利张开。

ex.en: Rescue teams used parachutes to deliver essential supplies to villages isolated by severe flooding.
ex.zh: 救援队利用降落伞向被严重洪灾隔绝的村庄投送必需物资。

ext.tip: 作动词时，既可指人跳伞，也可指空投物资。
senses: Equipment that slows a fall through the air
To jump or drop something from aircraft using a parachute

ex.en: A passenger left a blue umbrella on the bus.
ex.zh: 一位乘客把一把蓝色雨伞落在了公交车上。

ex.en: Improved rail services could increase passenger numbers and reduce reliance on private cars.
ex.zh: 改善铁路服务可以增加乘客数量，减少人们对私家车的依赖。

ext.tip: 指乘坐交通工具的人，不包括驾驶员或机组人员。
senses: Someone travelling in a vehicle without driving or operating it

ex.en: We waited on the platform as the train approached.
ex.zh: 火车驶近时，我们正在站台上等候。

ex.en: Online learning platforms allow students in remote areas to access courses that are unavailable locally.
ex.zh: 在线学习平台让偏远地区的学生能够学习当地没有开设的课程。

ext.tip: 在站台上用on the platform，不用in。
senses: The area beside railway tracks where passengers board trains.
A raised surface where people can stand or perform.
A service or system for sharing information or doing activities.

ex.en: Our house overlooks the railway near the old bridge.
ex.zh: 从我们家能望见旧桥附近的铁路。

ex.en: Investment in railway networks can reduce road congestion while improving access to employment in neighbouring cities.
ex.zh: 投资铁路网络可以缓解道路拥堵，同时方便人们前往邻近城市就业。

ext.tip: railway常用于英式英语，美式常用railroad。
senses: Tracks and services used by trains to transport people or goods.

ex.en: We watched the rocket rise above the clouds.
ex.zh: 我们看着火箭升到云层上方。

ex.en: As housing demand continues to grow, rents may rocket in cities with limited space for new development.
ex.zh: 随着住房需求持续增长，新开发空间有限的城市可能出现租金飞涨。

ext.tip: 作动词常描述价格等猛涨，比increase语气更强。
senses: A vehicle driven forward by powerful gases, often into space

ex.en: The child pushed her scooter along the smooth path.
ex.zh: 那个孩子蹬着滑板车沿着平坦的小路前进。

col: 骑滑板车或踏板摩托车

ex.en: Shared electric scooter schemes may reduce short car journeys if cities provide safe routes and suitable parking areas.
ex.zh: 如果城市提供安全路线和合适的停车区域，共享电动滑板车项目可能减少短途驾车出行。

ext.tip: 可指站着骑的滑板车，也可指踏板式小摩托。
senses: A small wheeled platform with handlebars, ridden standing up.
A small motorcycle with a low platform for your feet.

ex.en: The children built a spaceship from cardboard boxes.
ex.zh: 孩子们用纸板箱做了一艘宇宙飞船。

ex.en: Designing a spaceship for long journeys requires careful planning to protect astronauts from radiation and isolation.
ex.zh: 设计用于长途航行的宇宙飞船需要周密规划，以保护宇航员免受辐射和孤独的影响。

ext.tip: spaceship可数；spacecraft的单复数形式相同。
senses: A vehicle designed to travel through space.

ex.en: We took the subway to the museum this morning.
ex.zh: 今天上午我们乘地铁去了博物馆。

ex.en: Expanding subway networks can ease traffic congestion, provided that services remain affordable and accessible to local residents.
ex.zh: 扩建地铁网络可以缓解交通拥堵，前提是当地居民能够负担票价并方便地使用服务。

ext.tip: 美式指地铁；英式常指地下人行通道。
senses: An urban railway system that runs mainly underground.
A passage allowing people to walk beneath a road.

ex.en: Heavy traffic made us late for dinner again.
ex.zh: 交通拥堵又让我们吃晚饭迟到了。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。

ext.tip: 表示交通或车流时不可数，不说a traffic。
senses: Vehicles moving along roads in a particular area
The amount of data or messages passing through a system

ex.en: We caught the tram outside the library this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我们在图书馆外乘上了有轨电车。

ex.en: Investing in tram networks can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to busy city centres.
ex.zh: 投资建设有轨电车网络可以缓解交通拥堵，让人们更方便地前往繁忙的市中心。

ext.tip: 指车辆，不是轨道；美式英语常用streetcar。
senses: An electric passenger vehicle running on tracks along city streets.

ex.en: She rolled her wheelchair up the ramp into the library.
ex.zh: 她推着轮椅沿坡道进入了图书馆。

ex.en: Public buildings should provide step-free entrances and spacious lifts so that wheelchair users can move around independently.
ex.zh: 公共建筑应提供无台阶入口和宽敞的电梯，让轮椅使用者能够独立通行。

ext.tip: 说a wheelchair user，避免用带有束缚意味的表达。
senses: A wheeled chair used by someone who has difficulty walking.

ex.en: Thick fog hid the hills behind our house.
ex.zh: 浓雾遮住了我们屋后的山丘。

ex.en: Dense fog can disrupt transport networks, causing flight cancellations and increasing the risk of road accidents.
ex.zh: 浓雾可能扰乱交通网络，导致航班取消，并增加道路事故的风险。

ext.tip: fog比mist更浓；fog up常指玻璃蒙上雾气。
senses: a thick cloud near the ground that limits visibility
to become or make a surface covered with fine droplets

ex.en: The road was so foggy that we drove slowly.
ex.zh: 路上雾很大，我们只好慢慢开车。

ex.en: Foggy conditions can disrupt air travel, causing delays that affect both passengers and airport operations.
ex.zh: 大雾天气可能扰乱航空出行，造成延误，影响乘客和机场运营。

ext.tip: foggy既可形容天气，也可形容记忆模糊。
senses: filled with fog, making things difficult to see
unclear or difficult to remember or understand
